question.worked_solution:
We simplify each of the radical terms using the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}3\sqrt{18b}+3\sqrt{12b}+2\sqrt{27b} & = \\ 3\sqrt{9\cdot 2b}+3\sqrt{4\cdot 3b}+2\sqrt{9\cdot 3b} & = \\ 3\sqrt{9}\cdot \sqrt{2b}+3\sqrt{4}\cdot \sqrt{3b}+2\sqrt{9}\cdot \sqrt{3b} & = \\ 3\cdot 3\cdot \sqrt{2b}+3\cdot 2\cdot \sqrt{3b}+2\cdot 3\cdot \sqrt{3b} & = \\ 9\sqrt{2b}+6\sqrt{3b}+6\sqrt{3b} & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we combine the like terms:

$$
\begin{aligned}9\sqrt{2b}+6\sqrt{3b}+6\sqrt{3b} & = \\ 9\sqrt{2b}+(6+6)\sqrt{3b} & = \\ 9\sqrt{2b}+12\sqrt{3b} & \end{aligned}
$$
